exposure: COVID-19 PCR test result (positive vs negative)
COVID-19 diagnosis in the third trimester
outcome: Maternal outcomes (e.g., hospitalization time, ICU admission, mortality)
cohort: 109 pregnant women hospitalized with a COVID-19 diagnosis during the third trimester of pregnancy between March 1 and December 31, 2020.
finding: COVID-19 infection in the third trimester of pregnancy was not associated with adverse fetal and maternal outcomes when the disease was managed early and effectively.
